links.outcome: GPT-4 accuracy on emergency medicine board exam questions, including stepwise image-to-decision performance
links.effect: Overall accuracy 60.1%; text 60.2%, image 59.3%. Image type identification 100%, findings 86.4%, diagnostic reasoning 83.1%, final decision-making 59.3%.
links.quote: However, accuracy declined in diagnostic reasoning (83.1%) and further dropped in final decision-making (59.3%).

screen.reason: Evaluated GPT-4's visual and clinical reasoning performance on Taiwan Emergency Medicine Board Exam questions across five years without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
